counting_rules.obsolete_strict: line-anchored `^Obsolete\.` found in the page header, i.e. strictly before the `**Signature**` line; counted per member page, not per occurrence
counting_rules.obsolete_loose: case-insensitive `Obsolete` anywhere in the same page-header region (before `**Signature**`); counted per member page
counting_rules.pointer_returns: literal string `in-process, unmanaged C++` inside the `## Returns` section; counted per member page
counting_rules.pointer_params_only: the same literal present somewhere on the page but NOT inside `## Returns` (e.g. under a `## Parameters` ref/out parameter); counted per member page
counting_rules.zero_arg_methods: signature of the form `RetType Name()` with empty parentheses, excluding obsolete members and excluding members whose `## Returns` carries the pointer literal
counting_rules.properties_no_paren: signature containing no parentheses at all, of the form `RetType Name {get;}` or `{get; set;}`; counted per member page
counting_rules.no_signature_pages: pages with no `**Signature**` line anywhere (empty-shell pages)
counting_rules.members_total: number of .md files actually read in the directory, excluding `_overview.md` (directory listing holds 102 .md files in total)

anomalies: The official text in IGetAttachedEntityTypes.md line 17 and IGetLeaderPointsAtIndex.md line 21 reads 'in-process, in-process, unmanaged C++' with a duplicated 'in-process,' — the judged literal is still a substring (the trailing 'in-process, unmanaged C++'), so both pages count, but the source carries a typo.

GetAttachedEntityCount2.md is headed 'Obsolete. Superseded by [[IAnnotation::GetAtatchedEntityCount3]]' — the official text misspells the successor as 'GetAtatched…' (missing 't'), and no such member page exists under that name (the real page is GetAttachedEntityCount3.md).
GetAttachedEntityCount2.md lists '- [[IAnnotation Interface]]' twice in its See Also block (lines 25 and 26).

obsolete_loose equals obsolete_strict (17 == 17): every single Obsolete occurrence in this family is exactly the line-anchored 'Obsolete. Superseded by …' form, so the loose-minus-strict delta the prompt anticipated ('Obsolete for documents created in …' / 'Obsolete and not superseded. …') is 0 here.

GetMultiJogLeaderCount is a zero-arg method whose page has NO '## Returns' section at all, so it is counted in zero_arg_methods but has no Returns text to quote — such pages cannot be chosen as candidates.
SaveStyle.md and SetArrowHeadSizeAtIndex.md likewise lack any '## Returns' section despite being methods (both take parameters, so neither enters zero_arg_methods).

Nine obsolete pages are shell pages with a Signature but no '## Returns' section at all (GetAttachedEntities, GetBentLeader, GetLeader, GetNext, GetNext2, IGetAttachedEntities, IGetAttachedEntityCount, IGetNext, IGetNext2); GetAttachedEntities2, GetAttachedEntityCount2 and SetPosition do carry Returns.

Owner.md and OwnerType.md each state '**NOTE:** **This property is a get-only property.** **Set is not implemented**.' while their Signature lines still read '{get; set;}' — the two official statements contradict each other, so these two were counted as settable properties.

IGetPosition, IGetSpecificAnnotation and IGetTextFormat describe their returns as 'Pointer to an array of doubles' / 'Pointer to the IUnknown interface' / 'Pointer to [[ITextFormat]]' WITHOUT the judged literal 'in-process, unmanaged C++', so they pass the pointer test as non-pointer and therefore land in zero_arg_methods even though they are semantically pointer returns — this is the main口径 hazard in this family.
IGetDisplayData returns '[[IDisplayData]]', a real interface rather than a pointer, and is correctly counted as an ordinary zero-arg method.
On the five obsolete pages whose parameters are undocumented (Select, Select2, SelectByMark, SetLeader, SetLeader2) every '## Parameters' entry literally reads 'No description'.
AddOrUpdateStyle.md and LoadStyle.md both spell the Returns opening as 'Ture if …' (missing 'r') — an official typo, not a judgement problem.
The directory holds 102 .md files in total; _overview.md was excluded from every count, so members_total is 101.
All 101 pages contain a '**Signature**' line, so no_signature_pages is 0 for this family — every member page is a non-empty shell with at least a signature.
